# Inspechron

> Inspechron is an AI-assisted technical inspection app for professional home and property inspectors. It helps capture field evidence, detect defects with AI, and generate PDF reports in minutes.

Inspechron serves independent inspectors, property managers, builders, and insurance adjusters who need structured inspections, photo evidence, and professional deliverables.

## Product

- [Home — Inspechron](https://inspechron.com/): Main landing page with features, pricing, and download links.
- [Privacy policy](https://inspechron.com/privacy/): Data processing, account deletion, and Play Store disclosures.
- [Google Play — Inspechron app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aihomeinspectorpro.mobile): Download the mobile app.
